parameters.jsCode:
const input = $input.first().json;
const title = input.title || 'unknown';
const chapterNum = (input.chapterNum != null) ? input.chapterNum : 'unknown';
const chatId = input.chatId;

const pick = (arr) => arr[Math.floor(Math.random() * arr.length)];

const shots = [
  'extreme close-up on the eyes, tears or fury visible',
  'tight close-up on the face with sweat and fine detail',
  'dramatic low-angle hero shot looking up',
  'over-the-shoulder framing toward a second character',
  'tilted dutch angle for unease',
  'wide cinematic establishing shot with small figures',
  'stark silhouette backlit by a bright source',
  'split composition with two faces facing off',
  'from-behind reveal with the head turning toward camera',
  "worm's-eye view looking steeply upward"
];
const palettes = [
  'crimson red versus deep teal',
  'cold blue moonlight with sharp rim light',
  'warm gold and amber sunset',
  'neon purple and hot pink cyberpunk',
  'high-contrast black and white with a single red accent',
  'sickly green horror glow',
  'soft pastel tones cut by one harsh shadow',
  'desaturated stormy grey-blue',
  'fiery orange embers and drifting smoke',
  'electric cyan glow on near-black'
];
const emotions = ['rage', 'betrayal', 'heartbreak', 'cold determination', 'dread', 'smug dominance', 'desperate pleading', 'shock', 'quiet menace', 'manic glee'];
const environments = ['rain-soaked rooftop at night', 'glowing neon city street', 'ruined battlefield', 'empty classroom at dusk', 'old shrine steps', 'crowded train interior', 'dim blood-spattered alley', 'misty forest', 'collapsing building interior', 'grand throne room'];
const scenarios = ['a tense standoff', 'a betrayal being revealed', 'a forced impossible choice', 'a raw power and dominance clash', 'a rare unexpected intimate moment kept intense and not comedic', 'a last-second rescue', 'a villain mask-off reveal', 'a tearful goodbye', 'a vow of revenge', 'a forbidden alliance forming'];
const captionFormats = [
  { type: 'shock question', example: 'WHY DID HE LIE' },
  { type: 'blunt threat', example: "YOU ARE NEXT" },
  { type: 'hard declaration', example: 'THIS ENDS TONIGHT' },
  { type: 'countdown or number hook', example: '3 SECONDS LEFT' },
  { type: 'name-drop stakes', example: 'EVEN SHE CANT SAVE HIM' },
  { type: 'cryptic cliffhanger', example: 'SHE KNEW ALL ALONG' },
  { type: 'first-person taunt', example: 'I WARNED YOU' },
  { type: 'fatal stakes', example: 'ONE WONT SURVIVE' },
  { type: 'shocked reaction', example: 'HE ACTUALLY DID IT' },
  { type: 'reveal', example: 'THE REAL TRAITOR' }
];
const cases = ['ALL CAPS bold', 'Title Case bold', 'lowercase minimalist'];
const placements = ['top center', 'lower third', 'upper-left corner', 'centered over the subject'];

const fmt = pick(captionFormats);
const direction = {
  shot: pick(shots),
  palette: pick(palettes),
  emotion: pick(emotions),
  environment: pick(environments),
  scenario: pick(scenarios),
  captionType: fmt.type,
  captionExample: fmt.example,
  captionCase: pick(cases),
  captionPlacement: pick(placements),
  captionWords: 2 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 5)
};

const data = $getWorkflowStaticData('global');
const history = Array.isArray(data.thumbHistory) ? data.thumbHistory.slice(-25) : [];
const seed = Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10);

const system = [
  'You write prompts for an image generator (gpt-image-1-mini) that renders vertical 1024x1536 anime thumbnails for Instagram Reels. You are given strict CREATIVE DIRECTION and a list of recently used captions to avoid.',
  '',
  'HARD RULES:',
  '- Obey every direction field exactly. Never fall back to red-vs-blue lighting or a close-up unless the direction says so.',
  '- One clear focal subject; it must read at small size with minimal clutter.',
  '- Use characters and traits plausibly implied by the title, kept in character.',
  '- Produce EXACTLY ONE on-image caption that matches the given format, case, placement and length. Make it specific to this title and scenario, punchy and original.',
  '- The caption must NOT match or paraphrase any caption in the avoid list, and must NOT be a generic cliche like HE DID WHAT, SHE CHOSE HIM, IT IS OVER, NO WAY, THE TRUTH or SHOCKING.',
  '- The caption value must be PLAIN TEXT only: no markdown, asterisks, surrounding quotes or emojis.',
  '- Vary the wording on every generation.',
  '',
  'OUTPUT: return ONLY strict minified JSON with exactly these keys: {"caption": "exact caption text to render on the image", "image_prompt": "full detailed image prompt describing the scene per the direction AND explicitly instructing that the caption text be rendered large and bold at the specified placement and case"}. No markdown, no commentary.'
].join('\n');

const userPrompt = [
  'Title: ' + title,
  'Chapter: ' + chapterNum,
  '',
  'CREATIVE DIRECTION (follow every field exactly, do not fall back to defaults):',
  '- Shot/framing: ' + direction.shot,
  '- Color palette: ' + direction.palette,
  '- Dominant emotion: ' + direction.emotion,
  '- Environment: ' + direction.environment,
  '- Scenario: ' + direction.scenario,
  '- Caption format: ' + direction.captionType + ' (style reference only, do NOT copy this example: "' + direction.captionExample + '")',
  '- Caption case/style: ' + direction.captionCase,
  '- Caption placement: ' + direction.captionPlacement,
  '- Caption length: about ' + direction.captionWords + ' words',
  '',
  'AVOID these recently used captions (do not reuse or paraphrase any of them):',
  history.length ? history.map((c) => '- ' + c).join('\n') : '- (none yet)',
  '',
  'Variation token: ' + seed
].join('\n');

return [{ json: { chatId, title, chapterNum, direction, system, userPrompt } }];

const route = $('Route').first().json;
return [{ json: { chatId: route.chatId, text: 'chapter not found (404 from api.mangadex.org/chapter/' + route.chapterId + ')' }}];
